    Session handoff¶

    Living document, last changed 2026-11-06 at e95108d74.

    Two layers, linked: the programme-level state goes in the release records (shared, tracked), and the lane-level detail goes in a local handoff file (untracked, because it names worktrees and ports on this machine). Vendor memory is private to one tool and is never the only copy.

    Handoff granularity¶

    Keep one evolving handoff for a capability lane. Update it when the next owner, blocker, acceptance verdict or integration boundary changes; link immutable captures instead of restating every run. A helper commit or individual control is not a new lane or a reason to create another chat/handoff.

    Lead with capability/criterion closed, remaining blockers and next join/owner. Keep the source anchors and evidence needed to resume safely. Programme acceptance is recorded per coherent batch; substantive failures, decisions and ownership transfers are still recorded promptly. Follow the repository's completion-focused coordination contract in AGENTS.md and the applicable batch plan.

    1. Record the programme state (tracked)¶

    Append a dated Update table to releases/<product>-<version>/contents.md and any decision rows to decisions.md (the release-record skill). Hashes come from git log run now, not from a brief.

    2. Write the lane handoff (local)¶

    File: externals/work/HANDOFF-<lane>-<YYYY-MM-DD>.md. Template:

    # Handoff from <lane> (<date>, <time>Z)

Lane: <one line: what this lane owns>

## State
- <repo> `dev` = `<sha>` (fetched <time>Z). Merged this session, in order: #<n> (`<sha>`), ...
- Alignment `main` = `<sha>`; unpushed local commits: <list or "none">.
- Branch `<name>`: worktree `<path>`, head `<sha>` on `dev` `<sha>`, not pushed. Gates: <suite>
  <pass/fail/pending> on <tree>, <db version>; <matrix or lab result with its pin>.

## Done, and where it is recorded
- <item>: contents.md "Update, <date>" row; decisions.md row "<title>"; queue `<id>` state `<claim>`.

## Next, in order
1. <step>. Gate: <command>. Predicted: <result>. Owner: <lane or "unassigned">.
2. ...

## Local and unpushed
- <worktree path>: <branch> `<sha>`; uncommitted: <files or none>; do NOT stage: <files>.

## Traps met this session
- <symptom, exactly as seen> → <avoidance, exactly what to do>.

## Ownership
- <lane>: <what>. Send notes on <topic> to <person or lane>.

    Rules for the content:

    • Anchors, not adjectives. "dev is current" says nothing; dev f54941b5, fetched 07:40Z does.
    • Every claim has its evidence location or is marked read-derived.
    • Predicted results for each next step, so the next agent can tell a mismatch from a success.
    • What must not be staged is listed by path, because the index is shared.
    • No secrets, tokens or database URLs; container names and ports are fine.

    3. Link the two¶

    Put the handoff file's path in the contents.md Update row ("lane detail: externals/work/HANDOFF-<lane>-<date>.md, local"). If the handoff carries decisions or traps that outlive the lane, write them into AGENTS.md §5 or a skill in the same commit, so they reach every tool.

    4. Tell the person¶

    In the final message: the state in two lines, what is pushed and what is not, the next step and its owner, and the two file paths. Report a failing or skipped gate as such.
